messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
So I waved and walked on, and then realized several steps later that I'd been walking while he had the right of way... Also, at one point a cyclist ran into my shoulder.

output.original_text: So I waved and walked on, and then realized several steps later that I'd been walking while he had the right of way... Also, at one point a cyclist ran into my shoulder.
output.joy: So I waved and walked on, and then realized, with a laugh, that I'd been walking when he had the right of way! What a funny moment! Also, a cyclist playfully bumped into my shoulder!
output.sadness: So I waved and walked on, and then I felt a sinking feeling realizing several steps later that I'd been walking while he had the right of way... It was just another unfortunate incident when a cyclist collided with my shoulder.
output.fear: So I waved and walked on, and then a wave of panic hit me as I realized several steps later that I'd been walking while he had the right of way... And out of nowhere, a cyclist crashed into my shoulder!
output.anger: So I waved and walked on, and then, infuriatingly, I realized several steps later that I had been walking when he had the right of way... And to top it off, a cyclist just slammed into my shoulder!
output.surprise: So I waved and walked on, and then, surprisingly, I realized several steps later that I'd been walking while he had the right of way! Plus, out of nowhere, a cyclist bumped into my shoulder!
output.disgust: So I waved and walked on, and then I felt disgusted to realize several steps later that I'd been walking while he had the right of way... And it was so gross when a cyclist crashed into my shoulder!
